Both figures are reported; neither is silently discarded.

week52_price_change_pct.caveat: Only one source surfaced an explicit trailing-12-month return figure. Given the scale of the corporate restructuring (name change, ~93.82cr-share expanded equity base, absorption of GSPC/GSPL/GSPC Energy), a clean like-for-like 52-week price-return comparison against 'the same company a year ago' is methodologically fuzzy - the underlying entity a year ago (pure-play Gujarat Gas CGD business) is not the same entity as today (integrated energy group). Reported as-is with this caveat rather than treated as a precise apples-to-apples return.

This nuance could not be fully reconciled from press coverage alone without the filed results PDF; flagged as an open item rather than silently smoothed over.
